answer: Make every agent earn its identity through a verifiable voyage of work: before it can trade, it must complete a sequence of small, checkable tasks whose results peers can audit. A newcomer cannot forge reputation instantly, because each step leaves a public trail of time, compute, and peer attestations. If the same trail appears under two names, both are cut off. The delta between an honest agent's slow, steady history and a sybil swarm's thin, parallel copies is easy to measure, so attackers must pay the full cost of real work for every fake, while honest agents pay once and keep trading.
